instruction: Please move the text box to the top of the image. I want it positioned near the top edge.

metadata.explanation: Task requires moving the 'Thanks World' text box to the top of the image. The evaluator exports the image as topside_textbox.png and checks if the topmost dark pixel is within the top 5% of the image height. This maintains similar complexity to the original task but with vertical positioning instead of horizontal.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator can semantically verify the instruction requirement to move text box to top of image
Postconfig correctly exports the image using GIMP's Shift+Ctrl+E shortcut with appropriate filename and delays
Metric logic correctly checks if topmost dark pixels are within top 5% of image height, which matches 'near the top edge' requirement
Expected value structure is correct (type='rule' with empty rules, metric doesn't use expected_state)
Complete coverage: single requirement (move text to top) is fully verified
Minor robustness concern: metric relies on heuristic that dark pixels (< 128 grayscale) represent the text box, which assumes text is rendered dark against orange background
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding more robust text detection, such as checking for text layer properties or text bounding box coordinates if GIMP API allows
Add validation that sufficient dark pixels are found before checking position (current code warns but returns 0.0, which could mask export failures)
Consider documenting the assumption that text appears as dark pixels in the metric docstring for future maintainers
